`class LongSignal`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<Long>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.primitive` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [LongSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/primitive/LongSignal.java)

Signal of a `long` with arithmetic that writes its result, for large counts, sizes and timestamps.

## Description

It works like [`IntegerSignal`](/reference/signals/integersignal/) with `long` values: the operations overflow without error and `divide` rounds toward zero.

### divide

`this divide(long value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The LongSignal of value … cannot be divided by 0, check the divisor before calling divide(...)

Divides the value by `value`, rounding toward zero, then returns this signal.
A divisor of `0` throws an `IllegalArgumentException` at the call and leaves the value unchanged.
